title: Hearty Grassy Chinese Bottarga Ma La Tang
description: A midnight-craving Chinese dish featuring bottarga, glaze, and Sichuan flavors, served in a tagliere vessel. This kosher-friendly recipe combines grassy and shaggy textures with bold flavors.
instructions: Toast the Sichuan peppercorns in a dry pan over medium heat until fragrant.
Grind the toasted peppercorns into a fine powder using a spice grinder.
Combine the soy sauce, rice vinegar, and honey in a small bowl to make the glaze.
Add the grated bottarga to the glaze and stir until well combined.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the grassy herbs and scallions to the skillet and stir-fry until wilted.
Add the bottarga glaze to the skillet and stir-fry for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve the ma la tang in a tagliere vessel, garnished with additional grassy herbs if desired.
